findings.title: Built site's module docstring is stale relative to current src/GBGCodingTools.jl
locations: docs/build/index.html: rendered GBGCodingTools module docstring reads "the exit contract is 0 clean, 1 substantive finding, 2 cannot evaluate, 3 crash"
src/GBGCodingTools.jl:28-29: current source reads "the exit contract is 0 clean, 1 substantive finding, 2 a second finding, 3 crash"
findings.description: The built site (index.html and guide/verbs.html, both of which quote the module docstring's exit-code sentence) currently show the correct, sensible text "2 cannot evaluate" — but the live src/GBGCodingTools.jl module docstring this page is supposed to be rendered from has since been edited to the nonsensical "2 a second finding", which contradicts the identical 0/1/2/3 contract stated verbatim in main's own docstring (src/CLI/Main.jl, rendered correctly on guide/verbs.html), in the tool's own CLAUDE.md, and in index.html's separate hand-written paragraph ("0 when clean, 1 when it found something, 2 when it could not evaluate, 3 when it crashed"). Documenter renders a docstring verbatim from source at build time, so this built page can only currently read correctly because docs/build predates this source edit — the checked-in HTML artifact no longer reflects the current source it claims to document. The next docs rebuild (required before any release, per CLAUDE.md's release checklist and RULE.DOC.BUILD_VERIFY) will ship the broken sentence to the live site unless the source is fixed first. Failure scenario: a maintainer runs `julia --project=docs docs/make.jl` to cut a release; the regenerated index.html now advertises a self-contradictory exit-code contract ("2 a second finding") that no verb in the codebase actually implements.
findings.resolution_hint: Fix the module docstring in src/GBGCodingTools.jl line 29 to read "...1 substantive finding, 2 cannot evaluate, 3 crash..." (matching main's own docstring and the rest of the page), then rebuild docs/ so the built HTML reflects it.
findings.contradicts: src/CLI/Main.jl's own `main` docstring ("0 clean, 1 substantive finding, 2 cannot evaluate, 3 crash") and CLAUDE.md's "exit code 0 clean, 1 finding, 2 cannot evaluate, 3 crash"
